pages.text: The Bag of Horrors has made you feel a little bit... freaky. So, like any rational being, you've decided to replicate the garments of the Freakager and wear them.

The robes doesn't just make you look freaky, but also not only allows you to use the Bag of Horrors without needing to hold it (by pressing the same key as opening the Witches Robe's brewing menu), but also makes you proficient at throwing Iron Axes (and only Iron Axes and not other kinds unfortunately). When you're below half max health and holding two axes on both hands, using the robe's ability will give you the chance of throwing a barrage of axes in front of you.
The hat is not only snazzy but your Iron Axe doesn't get used up when thrown, only losing durability instead. Also, if you've somehow rode a Ragno, damage inflicted on you becomes halved.
